_authoritative_source: Gemini Notebook: Copy of Lira F&B Operations & Strategy (id: f945f20c-94a0-41e9-9aa4-011f996a57fa)

brand.name: Lira
brand.etymology: Derived from 'Libra' (equilibrium and balance). The 'b' was removed because 'Libra' sounded too legalistic. Lira symbolizes balanced drinks: flavor vs. health, sweetness vs. richness, price vs. artisan quality.
brand.genesis: Started in Grade 10 while studying Culinary Arts at a Hospitality Vocational School. Launched from literal zero with Rp34,000 out-of-pocket bootstrap capital, borrowing kitchen equipment from parents and operating without a laptop.

persona.visual: Pixelated Caleb avatar, 16/32-bit indie game aesthetic, POV brewing shots, stop-motion assets
persona.voice: ElevenLabs Instant Voice Clone (Caleb, voice_id: WVwVlhKdnZoCuTIoxjYr), casual Jakarta Indonesian (lo/gue)

physical_bottle_spec.cap: Ribbed Gold Screw Cap (tight seal, 100% leakproof)

sticker.top_section: Circular cream badge (#FAF7F0) with double dark green concentric ring (#1C4D25), cursive 'Lira' script, 2 green tea leaves on upper right, 3 green accent dots
sticker.bottom_section: Seamlessly connected rounded rectangular cream tab (#FAF7F0) with green outline containing the flavor name ('Matcha Latte Oatside', 'Milk Tea', 'Choco Hazelnut', 'Matcha Latte Classic') and order info ('DM to Secure your order at 0818 766 279 / And please follow @drinklira')
sticker.rule: NEVER use a flat artificial white circle or generic labels. Must preserve the full official uncut sticker with flavor pill tab.

physical_bottle_spec.leakproof_proof: 180-degree inverted bottle test suspended over an open laptop keyboard with zero leakage, bone-dry keys

cold_chain_and_logistics.packaging: Bagmart Size S Forest Green Thermal Cooler Bag with screen-printed white Lira logo ('Cold Crafted Fuel' / '@drinklira') and Aluminum Foil thermal inner lining

shelf_life.chiller_2_to_4_c: 14 to 21 days (2-3 weeks) fresh; up to 30 days if deep-frozen

dispatch_sop.mechanism: Customer pays strictly for product via BCA transfer; recipient pays shipping (Ongkir Bayar di Tujuan); flat Rp 1.000 Garansi (Insurance) fee covers in-transit damage. Zero offline meetups to protect operator time.

kitchen_and_ingredients.workflow: Hybrid 2L commercial blender (whipping matcha concentrate and powders without clumps) + 14L Royalstar Dispenser with nozzle tap for rapid, clean bottling
kitchen_and_ingredients.sweetener: 100% pure liquid stevia, 0g refined sugar, zero glycemic spike, zero insulin crash, zero brain fog

Matcha Latte Oatside.description: Rich Uji matcha whipped smooth and paired with creamy Oatside oat milk, sweetened only with pure stevia

Signature Milk Tea.description: Loose dark black tea leaves cold-steeped overnight, blended with real milk and pure stevia, zero non-dairy creamer

Choco Hazelnut.description: Bold roasted hazelnut chocolate drink, rich cocoa without heavy refined sugar syrup

Matcha Classic.description: Pure Japanese matcha with light fresh milk, earthy and invigorating

confidentiality_red_lines: NEVER mention exact school names (e.g. UPH College, SMK Baranangsiang)
NEVER mention teacher names or family details
NEVER mention secondary clients or freelance work ('WithUs')
NEVER mention internal financials (HPP, COGS, 66%, 74%, 20% fee, liquid war chest, bank balance numbers)
Scarcity is strictly non-numeric: 'limited batch', 'stok terbatas', 'batch minggu ini'. NEVER exact bottle counts like '42 botol' or '50 botol'
NEVER use the word 'ceremonial' (use 'premium matcha' or 'matcha Jepang murni')
NEVER include emojis in scripts or captions
